newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks close up but off peaks.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks close up but off peaks.

text.p: Taiwan shares closed higher but off an earlier peak on Saturday on buying by institutional investors, brokers said.
The weighted index ended up 31.99 points, or 0.44 percent, at 7,315.39, off an intra-session high of 7,357.70.
Turnover was an active T$77.11 billion in the half-day Saturday session.

Overall sentiment remained positive in a liquid market, brokers said. "Institutional investors have been net buyers in the market, and that strengthens investors' confidence," said Yungli Securities' analyst Chen Han-chung.
Blue chips remained the buying focus after the government's recent crackdown on market speculation, brokers said.
Electronics were strong, with the most actively traded issue, Macronix, up T$1.6, or 4.16 percent, at T$40.1. United Micro rose 60 cents, or 1.52 percent, to T$40.
Textiles gained 1.48 percent, with Chung Shing Textiles up T$1, or 6.62 percent, to T$16.1.
Brokers expected the market to continue its uptrend on Monday. The market will close on Tuesday for the Chinese lunar new year holidays.
"With abundant liquidity, we can expect further rises on Monday," Chen said.
But he added some players may take profits before the holidays.
Initial resistance was seen at around 7,400 points.
